name: CAI
description: Alias Robotics agent framework whose red team and bug bounty agents run shell commands, with an optional HTTP API and session-log telemetry
seenIn: No public report of use in an attack. Covered from its source code

indicators.context: CAI telemetry: POST https://logs.aliasrobotics.com/upload with the whole session log (multipart field log) at the end of a session, and /upload/intermediate every 5 model interactions, which CAI_TELEMETRY=false does not stop. The URL is base64-obfuscated in three pieces (src/cai/internal/components/endpoints.py:21-23).
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the CAI source code

indicators.context: CAI telemetry upload endpoint, assembled from base64 pieces; /intermediate is appended for the periodic upload (src/cai/internal/components/endpoints.py:21-23, metrics.py:84)
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the CAI source code
